parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

> This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute.

parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description:
The IDs of the Anti-DDoS Proxy instances.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~) operation to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Proxy instances.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

> This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo describe-port-max-conns --resource-group-id default --end-time 1583683200 --start-time 1582992000 --instance-ids ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
